result: Each agent built the two pages, then reviewed and revised them after the draft 'Before you finish' text. Shamsi preferred the revised pages for three of four agents, without knowing which was which. The main content started higher after the review in seven of eight pages: 36 to 210px on activity charts, about 100px on all sections in three builds. The one pair she preferred before had a sort bar that the revision left misaligned. Three agents considered a sidebar and rejected it because it would narrow the charts.
findings: The review pass helps: three of four revisions were preferred, and the main content moved up in seven of eight pages.
A review can also break things: one revision left the sort bar misaligned. The text should ask the agent to check the page still works after its changes.
Agents keep content the brief did not ask for (an "About these figures" section) and add breadcrumbs; the review text could ask whether each item is needed at all.
